title: Restoration of Musical Fountain at Vizhinjam Lighthouse
summary: Restoration of the musical fountain at Vizhinjam Lighthouse (Kochi Directorate), a tourism facility.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR of any nationalised/RBI approved bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; to reach tender inviting authority one day before last day of bid submission.
